body.p: Claims 1, 3, 16, 17, 21, and 24 are amended. Claims 14, 15, and 23 are canceled. Support for the claim amendments can be found in the application as originally filed, for example in paragraph [0057] and Figure 3. Claim 25 is new. No new subject matter is believed to be added.
The Examiner is thanked for indicating that claims 23 and 24 would be allowable if

rewritten in independent form. Claim 1 is amended to incorporate the allowable subject matter of claim 23 and intervening claims. Claim 25 is new and includes the allowable subject matter of claim 24 and intervening claims.

Claims 1-9, 12, 13, and 19-22 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as allegedly being unpatentable over U.S. Pub. No. 2022/0274693 (hereinafter "Sato") in view of U.S. Pub. No. 2023/0339601 (hereinafter "Marshall"). Claims 14-18 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as allegedly being unpatentable over Sato in view of Marshall, and further in view of U.S. Pub. No. 2022/0153407 (hereinafter "Howes").

Claim 1 is amended to incorporate subject matter indicated as allowable. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully submits that the standing rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 103 are rendered moot. Applicant respectfully requests that the standing rejections under 35 U.S.C. § 103 be withdrawn.

It is respectfully submitted that the claims are in condition for allowance and notification to that effect is earnestly requested. The Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned to facilitate prosecution of this application.

It is believed that the standing rejections have been rendered moot. However, the absence of a reply to a specific rejection, issue or comment does not signify agreement with or concession of that rejection, issue or comment. In addition, because the arguments made above may not be exhaustive, there may be reasons for patentability of any or all pending claims (or other claims) that have not been expressed. Finally, nothing in this document should be construed as intended to concede any issue with regard to any claim, except as specifically stated in this document, and the amendment of any claim does not necessarily signify concession of unpatentability of the claim prior to its amendment.
If necessary, please charge any additional fees or credit overpayment to Deposit Account No. 50-3521, referencing Attorney Docket No. 0253-098001.
